text:
Anya (Growth): Quick proposal: small PLG test 'LaunchLoop' — 350 users get 30 starter tokens + a focused prompt pack tied to their signup path. Hypothesis: targeted prompts + credit nudge -> faster time-to-first-meaningful-request (within 48h).

Kai: Love it. Who's in scope? webinar RSVPs and recent trials?

Anya (Growth): Yes. Split 60/40, 210 webinar, 140 trial. Randomize prompt-pack assignment 1:1:1 across three bundles (dev, marketing, docs).

Jess: I'll build the three packs (3 prompts each) and two email subject variants. Short in-console banner to surface the pack.

Samir: Routing plan: cohorts `ll_web` and `ll_trial`. Credit: 30 tokens, TTL=7d. Exclusions: paid users, credits_last_30d, heavy-usage. I'll post the config to #eng-infra.

Maya: Metrics: primary = pct with >=1 meaningful request in 48h. Secondary = avg tokens used by day7 and day14 retention. @data-bot pull last 30d baseline for these cohorts.

data-bot: Baseline query queued: `launchloop_baseline_v1`. Link: https://internal.data/reports/launchloop_baseline_v1 (internal). ETA ~20m.

Anya (Growth): Budget = 350*30 = 10.5k tokens. If we see >=10% uplift at 48h vs baseline we expand. Owners: Anya (lead), Jess (creative), Samir (routing), Maya (analysis). Check-in Thurs 10am PT.

Kai: Add small qualitative probe — 20 users get a one-question in-app ask after first request.

Jess: Will upload packs + Figma mocks EOD and include EN/ES copy.

Samir: Posting draft config now: https://internal.deploy/experiments/launchloop_v1 (ops link).

Maya: I'll prep the dashboard and set a regression alert. Rolling Monday unless concerns. :rocket:
